Lily and Anna are preparing a report about the dance studio. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. The school band practises on Fridays.

People around Anna often share different ideas about the dance studio. The piano room has become an important part of daily life. Anna wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The introduction explains the book's plan.

Anna has practiced tennis for three years and won a prize last term. Little by little, things began to change. Anna believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, happy workers stay longer; conversely, leaving hurts morale.

The dance studio looked quieter than usual that evening. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There are always more possibilities than we expect. What's more, the drum solo ran eleven minutes.
At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit. Anna will take part in a tennis match in March. The experience taught Anna more than any book could.
